comparison.objective: Pour simulated molten metal into the dry mould using a two-handle shank.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual vessel lifting, hazard selection, and controlled pouring.
comparison.success_condition: At least 90% enters the dry mould with limited spill, crucible replaced upright, and hands released.
comparison.reason: Two-handle pouring and hazard avoidance are unrelated to angular-stop adjustment and jam-nut retention.
